sections.title: Listening: Travel & Transport
sections.description: Listen once for gist and again for detail.

audio.transcript: We were travelling to Manchester when our train suddenly stopped outside Birmingham. At first, nobody knew what was happening. After twenty minutes, the driver explained that heavy rain had damaged a signal. We were moving again slowly when another announcement told us to change trains. We missed our connection, but a station employee calmly arranged new tickets. We finally arrived two hours late.

sections.title: Speaking: Travel & Transport
sections.description: Prepare briefly, record your response and review it.
questions: Describe a journey that did not go as planned.
sections.sampleAnswer: Last month, I was travelling home when my bus broke down. We waited for thirty minutes. Then the driver arranged another bus, and I arrived about an hour late.
